name: _reset_vector
source: reset dis: PRId<0x59 -> IOP code at BFC02000, else EE code at BFC00800

name: rom_exception_loop
source: reset dis: saves Cause/Status/EPC and spins

name: ee_reset
source: reset dis: EE COP0/TLB setup, calls rdram_init, ee_load_kernel, jumps 0x80001000

name: ee_load_kernel
source: reset dis: ROMDIR lookup of KERNEL, lq/sq copy to RAM, zero bss

name: romdir_find_root
source: reset dis: scans ROM for the RESET entry, returns {romBase, dirPtr, extinfo}

name: romdir_lookup
source: reset dis: finds a ROMDIR entry by name, returns {entry, dataPtr, extinfoPtr}

name: iop_reset
source: reset dis: IOP (R3000) side: cache init, SSBUS timing tables, finds IOPBOOT

name: iop_romdir_lookup
source: reset dis: IOP copy of the ROMDIR search

name: rdram_init
source: ROMDIR: RDRAM module, called from ee_reset
